decisions.decision: Phase 2 planned as 3 plans in 2 waves — 02-01 alone in wave 1, then 02-02 and 02-03 in parallel, both depending on 02-01.
decisions.rationale: 02-01 establishes the origin collapse and the compose stack that the other two plans build on; once it lands, the dev-loop work and the persistence work touch disjoint files.

decisions.decision: apiPort and its TAILNET_API_PORT source stay in src/Okozukai.AppHost/Program.cs.
decisions.rationale: 02-PATTERNS.md corrects 02-CONTEXT.md on this point — the API's own ASPNETCORE_URLS wiring still consumes them, so only the frontend API-URL injection is removed.

decisions.decision: COVERAGE.md declares no external API integration despite the detector firing six signals.
decisions.rationale: All six are false positives over the word 'API' referring to this repository's own src/Okozukai.Api project. Documented row by row so the gate is not re-litigated on resume.

decisions.decision: Development is made single-origin too, via a Vite dev proxy rather than a dev-only absolute base URL.
decisions.rationale: An absolute base URL anywhere in the frontend's API layer can be baked into a bundle; origin-relativity is a construction guarantee, not a default (D-06).
